regime_context: AI Infrastructure leads the rank board (score 1.56) with a modest 0.185 margin over US Energy Complex, but overall breadth of eligible themes is 'narrowing' (45% of universe) and rotation is 'directional: false' — this is a broad-trend, low-differentiation tape, not a decisive single-narrative regime. The backtest verdict confirms momentum rank is a focus lens (rank-IC ~0), so I treat ranks as attention, not alpha, and lean only where multiple coincident legs agree.
emerging_watch: Watching the AI Infrastructure / US Energy Complex leader gap: the margin is only 0.185 and would need to widen past ~0.35 (or alternatively flip sign for energy to take rank 1) to call a confirmed leadership handoff. Until then this is a two-leader tape, not a rotation.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: Leader with positive score and eligible trend-gate status, but durability bar reads only 0.5 'mixed' and breadth is a thin 0.125 — leadership is concentrated, not cohesive. The trend-gate leg (the one validated edge) is satisfied, which supports staying with the leader rather than fading it; crowding is not flagged. Conviction stays low because rank is a focus lens and breadth is weak.
theses.dissent: Breadth of 0.125 and a 0.5 durability bar suggest a hollow leadership — the index-level SMH proxy may be moving on a few large constituents (Nvidia-type concentration) rather than a broad AI-infra upcycle, making this fragile to a single-stock de-rating.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: The challenger with the strongest breadth on the board (0.636) and a higher durability bar (0.62) than the leader, eligible under the trend gate. Highest breadth among eligible scorable themes means participation is broad rather than single-stock-driven. The re-assertion of energy alongside AI suggests the market is rewarding two distinct pro-cyclical pockets; I express this as a hold-and-monitor lean rather than a trade because momentum rank carries no forward edge.
theses.dissent: Energy is tightly coupled to spot crude and OPEC+ headline risk; a single supply policy surprise (unscheduled_share is 1.0, so headline-driven vol is elevated) can reverse the complex regardless of its technical trend health.

theses.thesis: Eligible, trend-tagged, high durability (0.75) and solid breadth (0.6) — among the better all-around coincident textures.
